grammar.pattern: 主语 + 被 + 施事 + 动作；省略施事
grammar.purpose: Follow the affected item in a passive
grammar.explanation: 行李被同学移到门后了 names the agent. 行李被移到门后了 does not. Passive wording alone does not justify inventing an agent or intention. This expands the earlier 在雨中被弄湿 event with an explicit agent and result location.

examples.zh: 行李被同学移到门后了。
examples.py: xíng lǐ bèi tóng xué yí dào mén hòu le .
examples.en: A classmate moved the luggage behind the door.

examples.py: dài zi bèi huà pò le .
examples.en: The bag was cut or scratched open.

examples.py: bāo bèi fàng zài yī jià páng biān .
examples.en: The bag was put beside the clothes rack.

commonMistakes.wrong: 行李被移走了，所以一定是她。
commonMistakes.right: 行李被移走了，还不知道是谁。
commonMistakes.why: An omitted agent cannot be inferred with certainty.

grammar.explanation: 我是来领行李的 emphasizes the stated purpose. 是这个包被移走了 corrects which bag was moved. Emphasis is a speaker’s assertion, not independent evidence; distinguish this from the previously taught identification 是.

examples.py: wǒ shì lái lǐng xíng lǐ de .
examples.en: I came to collect the luggage.

examples.py: shì zhè gè bāo bèi yí zǒu le .
examples.en: It is this bag that was moved.

examples.py: wǒ shì zhēn de méi kàn jiàn .
examples.en: I really did not see it.

commonMistakes.wrong: 她说是真的，所以不需要核对。
commonMistakes.right: 她强调是真的，仍要核对具体事实。
commonMistakes.why: Emphasis does not replace checking facts.

dialogue.title: The missing bag
dialogue.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
dialogue.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 我的包怎么不在衣架旁边了？
lines.py: wǒ de bāo zěn me bù zài yī jià páng biān le ?
lines.en: Why isn't my bag beside the coat rack?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 是这个蓝色的吗？工作人员刚拿到门后了。
lines.py: shì zhè gè lán sè de ma ? gōng zuò rén yuán gāng ná dào mén hòu le .
lines.en: The blue one? A staff member just moved it behind the door.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 门后？我刚看过，没看见。
lines.py: mén hòu ? wǒ gāng kàn guò , méi kàn jiàn .
lines.en: Behind the door? I just looked and didn't see it.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 门开着的时候会挡住，你先把门关一点。
lines.py: mén kāi zhe de shí hou huì dǎng zhù , nǐ xiān bǎ mén guān yī diǎn .
lines.en: The open door hides it. Close the door a little.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 看到了。我的行李怎么放在这里？
lines.py: kàn dào le . wǒ de xíng lǐ zěn me fàng zài zhè lǐ ?
lines.en: There it is. Why is my luggage here?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 刚才来了很多人，你的包放在路中间。他们怕有人被它挡住。
lines.py: gāng cái lái le hěn duō rén , nǐ de bāo fàng zài lù zhōng jiān . tā men pà yǒu rén bèi tā dǎng zhù .
lines.en: A lot of people came in. Your bag was in the way, and they were worried it would block someone.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 是我没放好。我来领行李，要跟谁说？
lines.py: shì wǒ méi fàng hǎo . wǒ lái lǐng xíng lǐ , yào gēn shéi shuō ?
lines.en: I didn't put it away properly. Who should I tell before collecting it?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 桌子旁边那个人。你告诉她是你的包就行。
lines.py: zhuō zi páng biān nà gè rén . nǐ gào sù tā shì nǐ de bāo jiù xíng .
lines.en: The person beside the table. Tell her it's yours.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 包带有点儿破了，我得小心拿。
lines.py: bāo dài yǒu diǎn ér pò le , wǒ děi xiǎo xīn ná .
lines.en: The strap's a little damaged. I need to carry it carefully.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我帮你拿一边。别急，车还有十分钟才来。
lines.py: wǒ bāng nǐ ná yī biān . bié jí , chē hái yǒu shí fēn zhōng cái lái .
lines.en: I'll take one side. No rush; the bus won't be here for ten minutes.
lines.speaker: b

choices: Partly closing the door reveals the bag

reading.title: Record, then confirm
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 演出结束，我回去找衣架旁边的包。那里多了几件外套，却没有我的蓝色包。
lines.py: yǎn chū jié shù , wǒ huí qù zhǎo yī jià páng biān de bāo . nà lǐ duō le jǐ jiàn wài tào , què méi yǒu wǒ de lán sè bāo .
lines.en: After the performance I returned to the coat rack. There were more coats there, but my blue bag was missing.

lines.zh: 我问了工作人员，她说已经放到门后。我过去看，门开着，下面只有一双鞋。
lines.py: wǒ wèn le gōng zuò rén yuán , tā shuō yǐ jīng fàng dào mén hòu . wǒ guò qù kàn , mén kāi zhe , xià miàn zhǐ yǒu yī shuāng xié .
lines.en: A staff member said it had been moved behind the door. I looked, but with the door open all I could see was a pair of shoes.

lines.zh: 朋友把门慢慢关上一点，我才看见包在墙边。它没有丢，只是刚才被门挡住了。
lines.py: péng you bǎ mén màn màn guān shang yī diǎn , wǒ cái kàn jiàn bāo zài qiáng biān . tā méi yǒu diū , zhǐ shì gāng cái bèi mén dǎng zhù le .
lines.en: My friend partly closed the door. The bag was against the wall: it wasn't lost, just hidden by the door.

lines.zh: 领行李的时候，我发现包带破了一小块。工作人员给我一根绳子，朋友帮我把它连起来。
lines.py: lǐng xíng lǐ de shí hou , wǒ fā xiàn bāo dài pò le yī xiǎo kuài . gōng zuò rén yuán gěi wǒ yī gēn shéng zi , péng you bāng wǒ bǎ tā lián qǐ lái .
lines.en: On collecting it I found a small tear in the strap. The staff member gave me cord, and my friend helped secure it.

lines.zh: 我们一起把包拿到车站。车还没来，朋友说幸好你没急着自己拿，不然可能走一半就断了。
lines.py: wǒ men yì qǐ bǎ bāo ná dào chē zhàn . chē hái méi lái , péng you shuō xìng hǎo nǐ méi jí zhe zì jǐ ná , bù rán kě néng zǒu yí bàn jiù duàn le .
lines.en: We carried it to the stop. The bus hadn't arrived. My friend said it was lucky I hadn't rushed to carry it alone: the strap might have snapped halfway.

lines.zh: 回家以后，我先把东西拿出来，再给旧包拍了一张照片。下次出门，我会换一个好一点的包。
lines.py: huí jiā yǐ hòu , wǒ xiān bǎ dōng xi ná chū lái , zài gěi jiù bāo pāi le yī zhāng zhào piān . xià cì chū mén , wǒ huì huàn yī gè hǎo yī diǎn de bāo .
lines.en: At home I unpacked and photographed the old bag. I'd use a better bag for my next trip.

It was never brought to the performance

extraReadings.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
extraReadings.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 你说包丢了，我怎么就在门后找到了？
lines.py: nǐ shuō bāo diū le , wǒ zěn me jiù zài mén hòu zhǎo dào le ?
lines.en: You said the bag was lost. How did I find it behind the door?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那是你眼睛好，我刚才只看见鞋。
lines.py: nà shì nǐ yǎn jīng hǎo , wǒ gāng cái zhǐ kàn jiàn xié .
lines.en: You've got better eyes. I only saw the shoes.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 门那么大，你倒是看不见。
lines.py: mén nà me dà , nǐ dǎo shì kàn bú jiàn .
lines.en: Yet you somehow missed that huge door.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好了，包找到了，别再笑我。
lines.py: hǎo le , bāo zhǎo dào le , bié zài xiào wǒ .
lines.en: All right, we found the bag. Stop laughing at me.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 行，你拿这边，我拿另一边。
lines.py: xíng , nǐ ná zhè biān , wǒ ná lìng yī biān .
lines.en: Fine. You take this side; I'll take the other.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 谢谢。下次我先找门，不找鞋。
lines.py: xiè xiè . xià cì wǒ xiān zhǎo mén , bù zhǎo xié .
lines.en: Thanks. Next time I'll look for the door, not the shoes.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我的背有点儿疼。
lines.py: wǒ de bèi yǒu diǎn ér téng .
lines.en: My back hurts a little.

lines.zh: 她的背上沾了一点土。
lines.py: tā de bèi shàng zhān le yī diǎn tǔ .
lines.en: There's a little soil on her back.

lines.zh: 这块板可以做桌面。
lines.py: zhè kuài bǎn kě yǐ zuò zhuō miàn .
lines.en: This board can make a tabletop.

lines.zh: 门后有一块木板。
lines.py: mén hòu yǒu yī kuài mù bǎn .
lines.en: There's a wooden board behind the door.

lines.zh: 我们先保住这个位置。
lines.py: wǒ men xiān bǎo zhù zhè gè wèi zhì .
lines.en: Let's hold on to this spot first.

lines.zh: 这次至少要保住前两名。
lines.py: zhè cì zhì shǎo yào bǎo zhù qián liǎng míng .
lines.en: We need to keep a top-two place this time at least.

lines.zh: 请保护好自己的书。
lines.py: qǐng bǎo hù hǎo zì jǐ de shū .
lines.en: Please take care of your books.

lines.zh: 这个袋子可以保护相机。
lines.py: zhè gè dài zi kě yǐ bǎo hù xiàng jī .
lines.en: This bag can protect the camera.

lines.zh: 往前走两步，就能看见门。
lines.py: wǎng qián zǒu liǎng bù , jiù néng kàn jiàn mén .
lines.en: Take two steps forward to see the door.

lines.zh: 她向后退了一步。
lines.py: tā xiàng hòu tuì le yī bù .
lines.en: She stepped backward.

lines.zh: 我昨天看了一部电影。
lines.py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn le yī bù diàn yǐng .
lines.en: I watched a film yesterday.

lines.zh: 他带了两部手机。
lines.py: tā dài le liǎng bù shǒu jī .
lines.en: He brought two phones.

lines.zh: 绳子突然断了。
lines.py: shéng zi tū rán duàn le .
lines.en: The rope suddenly snapped.

lines.zh: 这根线中间断了一段。
lines.py: zhè gēn xiàn zhōng jiān duàn le yī duàn .
lines.en: Part of this cable is broken in the middle.

lines.zh: 这把刀放在厨房里。
lines.py: zhè bǎ dāo fàng zài chú fáng lǐ .
lines.en: This knife belongs in the kitchen.

lines.zh: 请把刀收好。
lines.py: qǐng bǎ dāo shōu hǎo .
lines.en: Please put the knife away.

lines.zh: 带一件外套，防着晚上变冷。
lines.py: dài yī jiàn wài tào , fáng zhe wǎn shang biàn lěng .
lines.en: Bring a coat in case it gets cold tonight.

lines.zh: 出门记得防雨。
lines.py: chū mén jì de fáng yǔ .
lines.en: Remember rain protection when going out.

lines.zh: 袋子破了一个洞。
lines.py: dài zi pò le yī gè dòng .
lines.en: There's a hole in the bag.

lines.zh: 这双鞋太破了，得换了。
lines.py: zhè shuāng xié tài pò le , děi huàn le .
lines.en: These shoes are worn out; I need new ones.

lines.zh: 大雨破坏了这条小路。
lines.py: dà yǔ pò huài le zhè tiáo xiǎo lù .
lines.en: The heavy rain damaged this path.

lines.zh: 别破坏我们摆好的东西。
lines.py: bié pò huài wǒ men bǎi hǎo de dōng xi .
lines.en: Don't damage the things we've set up.

lines.zh: 我的行李已经放在车上了。
lines.py: wǒ de xíng lǐ yǐ jīng fàng zài chē shàng le .
lines.en: My luggage is already in the vehicle.

lines.zh: 她只带了一件行李。
lines.py: tā zhǐ dài le yī jiàn xíng lǐ .
lines.en: She brought just one piece of luggage.

lines.zh: 这间屋子比旁边的亮。
lines.py: zhè jiān wū zi bǐ páng biān de liàng .
lines.en: This room is brighter than the neighbouring one.

lines.zh: 屋子里还有两把椅子。
lines.py: wū zi lǐ hái yǒu liǎng bǎ yǐ zi .
lines.en: There are two more chairs in the room.

lines.zh: 请把外套放在衣架上。
lines.py: qǐng bǎ wài tào fàng zài yī jià shàng .
lines.en: Please put your coat on the hanger.

lines.zh: 这个衣架已经坏了。
lines.py: zhè gè yī jià yǐ jīng huài le .
lines.en: This hanger's broken.

lines.zh: 这家店卖儿童服装。
lines.py: zhè jiā diàn mài ér tóng fú zhuāng .
lines.en: This shop sells children's clothing.

lines.zh: 演出的服装放在箱子里。
lines.py: yǎn chū de fú zhuāng fàng zài xiāng zi lǐ .
lines.en: The performance costumes are in the case.

lines.zh: 我夏天喜欢穿短裤。
lines.py: wǒ xià tiān xǐ huān chuān duǎn kù .
lines.en: I like shorts in summer.

lines.zh: 这条短裤有两个口袋。
lines.py: zhè tiáo duǎn kù yǒu liǎng gè kǒu dài .
lines.en: These shorts have two pockets.

lines.zh: 我明天去领新书。
lines.py: wǒ míng tiān qù lǐng xīn shū .
lines.en: I'll collect the new books tomorrow.

lines.zh: 请到门口领自己的东西。
lines.py: qǐng dào mén kǒu lǐng zì jǐ de dōng xi .
lines.en: Please collect your belongings at the entrance.

lines.zh: 她抓着我的手，不想放开。
lines.py: tā zhuā zhe wǒ de shǒu , bù xiǎng fàng kāi .
lines.en: She held my hand and didn't want to let go.

lines.zh: 先抓住绳子，再慢慢站起来。
lines.py: xiān zhuā zhù shéng zi , zài màn màn zhàn qǐ lái .
lines.en: Hold the rope before slowly standing.

lines.zh: 我抓住了快掉下来的杯子。
lines.py: wǒ zhuā zhù le kuài diào xià lái de bēi zi .
lines.en: I caught the cup as it was falling.

lines.zh: 他想抓住这次机会。
lines.py: tā xiǎng zhuā zhù zhè cì jī huì .
lines.en: He wants to seize this opportunity.

lines.zh: 门会自动关上。
lines.py: mén huì zì dòng guān shang .
lines.en: The door closes automatically.

lines.zh: 这个灯晚上会自动打开。
lines.py: zhè gè dēng wǎn shang huì zì dòng dǎ kāi .
lines.en: This light comes on automatically at night.

lines.zh: 大家围着桌子坐下。
lines.py: dà jiā wéi zhe zhuō zi zuò xià .
lines.en: Everyone sat around the table.

lines.zh: 几个人围在门口等消息。
lines.py: jǐ gè rén wéi zài mén kǒu děng xiāo xī .
lines.en: Several people gathered at the door awaiting news.

lines.zh: 学校周围有很多小店。
lines.py: xué xiào zhōu wéi yǒu hěn duō xiǎo diàn .
lines.en: There are many shops around the school.

lines.zh: 我看了看周围，没有认识的人。
lines.py: wǒ kàn le kàn zhōu wéi , méi yǒu rèn shi de rén .
lines.en: I looked around and didn't see anyone I knew.
